messages:
lina_ops: Incoming H100 pallet hit depot QA. 30 units, QA flagged 6 DOA and 4 units with firmware mismatch (won't pass bootloader). Depot put whole pallet on hold pending vendor guidance.

oz_procure: Oof. Do we have photos/serials? VendorX shipment AWB and manifest?

lina_ops: Uploaded evidence + manifest: s3://redwood-procure/vendorx/1764312345/qa_photos.zip
```
AWB: 321-09876543
Manifest: H100-A1001..H100-A1030
DOA: A1005,A1012,A1029,A1030,A1008,A1017
FW-mismatch: A1002,A1009,A1015,A1022
```

rafi_infra: Immediate risk: eu-dedicated pool loses ~12% capacity if we quarantine these. Canary capacity fine for now but scheduled A/B rollouts next Tue could be impacted. ETA to fix matters.

pete_sre: Any chance depot can reflash FW? That would be fastest. Depot tech says they need vendor-signed image and signed manifest to avoid warranty void.

oz_procure: VendorX's initial response: mismatch likely from factory image variant. They'll accept depot reprovision but only if we sign an RMA labor clause (payable) or take full replacement air at vendor expense. They prefer depot repair to avoid cross-border freight.

lina_ops: Depot quoted reprovision labor 1.5h/unit + bench time, turnaround 3-6 days for the 4 mismatch units. DOA units need RMA replacement.

oz_procure: Vendor asks Redwood to choose: (A) Depot reprovision + vendor credits 50% of labour ( detailed) OR (B) Air-replace DOA + mismatch units at vendor cost with FAST-ship (2-6 days) but vendor wants to escalate insurance claim for DOA to avoid bearing full logistic.

maya_product: We have two customers on dedicated contracts in EU with strict uptime windows. Product needs estimate on capacity & mitigation and a short, neutral customer note.

rafi_infra: Mitigation options: 1) Pull 10 units from loaner/edge-temp pool and rotate non-critical workloads to us-central for 48h. 2) Promote canaries to reduce blast radius. 3) Limit long-running batch jobs.

pete_sre: I'd prefer option 1 + batch throttles. Depot reprovision is cheapest but slower. Air-replace fastest but cost + customs risk.

oz_procure: Cost numbers: Depot reprovision labor ~80/unit (1.5h@50/hr + depot handling) => total ~120/unit. Vendor credits 50% => Redwood pay ~60/unit for 4 units = 240. Air-replace surcharge = 9k (includes air freight + DOA replacement). Vendor proposing to split insurance claim but wants contribution.

lina_ops: Given SLAs, we should avoid air unless finance ok. Can we get loaners? Supplybot, what's loaner pool status?

supplybot: Loaner pool snapshot: LOANER-H100 total=12 available=8. Tags created: HOLD-RMA-1764312345 on H100-A1002..A1030.

rafi_infra: 8 available loaners buys a partial buffer. We need at least 10 to avoid scheduling impact next 48h.

oz_procure: I'll press VendorX: ask them to cover 100% of depot labor for reprovision as goodwill (shipment arrived mislabeled). If they refuse, propose Redwood covers labor for mismatch units but vendor covers DOA replacements + freight.

maya_product: Draft customer-facing bullet points: 1) Localized EU capacity maintenance underway. 2) We've temporarily quarantined a subset of hardware for safety and compliance. 3) We've activated cross-region capacity and loaner pool. 4) Customers on Dedicated will see prioritization of critical SLAs. Will hold until ops confirms plan.

pete_sre: Also: capture metrics for impacted fleets: current queued requests + CPU/GPU backlog. I'll post a short grafana snapshot in 10m.

oz_procure: VendorX responded: they will cover DOA replacements (air) but require Redwood to sign an LOA for tariff recovery and to cover depot labor for reprovision at our cost unless we escalate. They offered to discount freight by 40% if we commit to a 2nd reorder of 50 units in Q4.

lina_ops: Not comfortable taking labor hit. Suggest negotiation: vendor covers depot labor for reprovision and DOA freight at 60% vendor / 40% Redwood unless they commit to the Q4 reorder discount.

rafi_infra: Time is sensitive. If vendor stalls >24h we trigger full region-failover playbook.

oz_procure: Looping finance: @sarah_finance in #finance - can we pre-approve up to 5k to cover possible 40% freight share while negotiation continues?

maya_product: Also flag legal if vendor wants LOA language. Don't promise tariff recovery terms w/o legal signoff.

supplybot: Inventory system: placed quarantine flag QUARANTINE-RMA-1764312345 on serials and created temporary loaner assignment ticket LN-1764312345.

lina_ops: Update: depot tech confirmed they can reprovision 4 mismatch units tomorrow if vendor provides signed image. Diego/Oz can we get vendor to drop signed image into s3 or provide checksum?

oz_procure: Asked vendor to upload signed image to s3 and confirm checksum. Asked them for a commit on labor coverage. ETA response 2-3h.

pete_sre: Grafana snapshot: eu-dedicated queued GPU-jobs +34% last hour, loaner pool assignment will reduce queue by ~18% if we cold-start them. Posting link: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/edge/queue?panelId=7

maya_product: I'll prepare the customer note and include the Grafana link + mitigation steps. Keep neutral tone.

lina_ops: Vendor just uploaded image: s3://vendorx-release/images/h100/fw_v1.2.3-signed.bin and checksum matches. Depot can reprovision tomorrow morning. Vendor still silent on labor credits.

oz_procure: Negotiation move: offer vendor 20% share of reprovision labor and Redwood covers rest if vendor signs Q4 reorder discount. Sending amendment now.

supplybot: System note: loaner assignment LN-1764312345 reserved 10 units for eu-dedicated workload.

lina_ops: Ok locking this plan: 1) Reserve 10 loaners into pool to cover next 48h 2) Depot to reprovision 4 mismatch units tomorrow 3) DOA replacements to be shipped as vendor confirmed (timeline 2-3 days) 4) Finance to pre-authorize up to 5k for possible freight split.

pete_sre: If any unit fails post-reprovision we'll escalate to full RMA and re-evaluate.

maya_product: Customer note queued. Will publish once Oz confirms vendor amendment and Finance ack.

oz_procure: Vendor accepted 20% labor share and Q4 reorder term. I signed amendment. Vendor to confirm AWB for DOA replacements in 1-2h.

lina_ops: Great. Closing loop here: depot reprovision scheduled 08:00 CET tomorrow. Loaners assigned. Will update when depot posts serial scans. :white_check_mark:
